title: Pandas Pipelines
summary: dplyr in pandas: filter rows, assign() new columns, value_counts(), groupby().agg() and sort_values().
hints: Filter with a condition in brackets: `first = log[log["mission_number"] == 1]`. Then `first = first.assign(age=first["year_of_mission"] - first["year_of_birth"])`.
`by_nation = first["nationality"].value_counts()` is sorted already; `by_nation.index[0]` is the top label.
